PANDA(1)                        Panda CLI Manual                        PANDA(1)

NAME
    panda - synchronize Solutions tasks with a local task workspace

SYNOPSIS
    panda [global options] <command> [arguments]

DESCRIPTION
    Panda pulls Solutions tasks into Markdown and JSON files, lets you edit them
    locally, and publishes selected changes with push.
    Use command-specific help for detailed syntax and options: panda <command>
    --help or panda help <command>.

COMMANDS
    panda login [email]
        Authenticate with Solutions and save a session.

    panda logout
        Clear the saved Solutions login session.

    panda config set project <name>
        Validate and select the active project.

    panda config get project
        Display the active project.

    panda config set api-url <url>
        Set the Solutions API base URL.

    panda config get api-url
        Display the Solutions API base URL.

    panda path
        Print the selected project's workspace path.

    panda doctor [--json]
        Inspect local configuration and workspace health without changing files.
        Checks are local-only and read-only. Warnings are reported but failures
        determine the exit status.

    panda completion <bash|zsh|fish>
        Print shell completion setup code.

    panda labels [list|create|edit|delete]
        Manage project labels locally.

    panda packages [list|create|edit|delete]
        Manage project packages (epics) locally.

    panda list [status filters] [assignee/reviewer filters] [other filters] [--wide]
    [--json]
        List tasks with package, labels, and effort totals.
        Status filters: --current, --staging, --released, --discarded, --all,
        --status <status,...>.
        Relationship filters: repeatable --assignee <member,...> and --reviewer
        <member,...>; values within each filter match any member, and supplied
        filters combine with AND. Use me or none.
        Other filters: --no-complexity, --no-description, --no-package, --no-labels.
        Output: --json emits a versioned JSON document without paging or terminal
        formatting.

    panda browse [list filters]
        Browse local tasks interactively without changing the workspace.
        Interactive and read-only; accepts the same task filters as list, except
        --json.

    panda estimate [status[,status...]] [--type <type,...>] [--all]
        Quickly assign complexity to tasks in selected statuses and types.

    panda pull
        Fetch project tasks, catalogs, and members into the workspace.

    panda diff [task] [--verbose|-v] [--summary|-s] [--json]
        Review pending local changes.
        Output: --json emits structured changes and summary counts; --verbose adds
        Markdown line changes.

    panda push [taskNumber|draft-N ...] [--json]
        Publish all local edits or only selected tasks; project catalogs are
        synchronized too.
        Output: --json emits per-task and catalog outcomes; task failures remain
        non-zero and are included in the document.

    panda create [title] [task field options]
        Create a task locally with interactive or noninteractive options.

    panda edit <task> [task field options|labels ...|package ...|assignees
    ...|release-notes ...|json]
        Edit task fields, description, and release notes.

    panda assign <task> <person[,person...]|none>|--status <status,...> [--priority
    ...] [--type ...]
        Assign people to a task or interactively assign filtered tasks.

    panda link <task>
        Print a canonical Markdown link to a verified synced task.

    panda edit-note <task> <note-file> [--file <path>]
        Edit one of your synced notes.

    panda view <task> [--no-description] [--no-notes] [--no-release-notes] [--json]
        Display a task's metadata, description, release notes, files, and notes.

    panda files [<task>|upload|download]
        List task file references, stage uploads, or download a file on demand.

    panda add-note <task> [text] [--file <path>]
        Stage a new task note.

    panda discard <task> [note]
        Stage a task discard and optional note.

    panda clean [task] [--yes]
        Discard local edits for one task or the project.

    panda help [command ...]
        Display this index or a command manual.

GLOBAL OPTIONS
    -h, --help                  Display the main manual. Append --help to a command
                                for its manual page.

ENVIRONMENT
    EDITOR                      Select the editor used by edit, edit-note, and
                                add-note.
    PAGER                       Select the pager used for long output; less is
                                configured to leave its output visible after exit.
    PANDA_API_URL               Override the configured Solutions API base URL.

FILES
    Configuration and task files are stored under the operating system's user config
    directory in panda-dashboard/. Run panda path to print the active workspace
    path.
